g.text: 1 bit per allele · shared between phasing and imputation · SIMD-accelerated
unphased input, and phased input by default (--keep-input-phase keeps the given phase)
Each sample phased as 2-3 copies (<= 1,000 samples)
In-memory handoff: phased haplotypes + shared bitmatrix (no file I/O)
chosen from the input: confident genotypes → genotype engine | low-coverage likelihoods or aligned reads → lcWGS engine
PBWT candidate selection (whole panel up to 16,000 haps)
PL VCF, or BAM / CRAM with native pileup + BAQ
Founder phasing HMM, re-committed every iteration
Tiled interpolation (1,024 × 4,096, L2-cache) · fused interpolate → encode → stream · DR2 · LD-corrected
Multi-format output (one interpolation pass, identical dosages)
Multi-chromosome: one SRP file, overlapped prefetch
Panels: BCF / VCF / BREF3 ↔ SRP, no external converter
